pxe_mapping_file_path.description: Optional path to the PXE mapping file. An empty value uses the current project input directory.

dns_enabled.description: Enable DNS-based hostname resolution via coresmd.

kernel_version_override.description: Optional kernel version to pin for boot image selection. Leave empty to auto-select latest.

additional_cloud_init_config_file.description: Path to additional cloud-init configuration file for stateless node provisioning. Leave empty to disable.

boot_kernel_params.description: Additional kernel command-line parameters applied to all functional groups.

catalog_file_path.description: Optional catalog JSON path. An empty value uses CATALOG_FILE_PATH or the standard catalog path.

enable_pxe_boot.description: Enable PXE boot through iDRAC for physical servers.

image_build_manager_output_path.description: Optional build_status.yml path. An empty value uses the current Image Build Manager project output.

repo_manager_output_path.description: Optional repo_status.yml path. An empty value uses the current Repo Manager project output.

dcgm_enabled.description: Enable NVIDIA DCGM (Data Center GPU Manager) installation on GPU nodes. DCGM is part of the CUDA toolkit and provides GPU monitoring and management capabilities.
